title: Juice N Power Watermelon Ice Power 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Watermelon Ice from Juice N Power is refreshment in a vape. Cool, clean, juicy Watermelon is lifted even further with a subtle streak of menthol for a crisp, sweet and invigorating vape sensation. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks.
